title: Laconic
summary: LACON'IC, LACON'ICAL, adjective [Latin laconicus, from Laconia or Lacomes, the Spartans.] 1. Short; brief; pithy; sententious; expressing much in few words, after the manner of the Spartans; as a laco

inlines.v: LACON'IC, LACON'ICAL, adjective [Latin laconicus, from Laconia or Lacomes, the Spartans.] 1. Short; brief; pithy; sententious; expressing much in few words, after the manner of the Spartans; as a laconic phrase. 2. Pertaining to Sparta or Lacedemonia.
